name: Dr. Asdaq Asim
review: I was nervous about getting braces at this age, but Dr. Asdaq explained the whole process so simply that all my fear went away. Started treatment the same week!

name: Dr. Asifa Iqbal
review: Took my daughter for braces after visiting 3 clinics. Dr. Asifa was the only one who took time to show us the before/after plan. Totally worth it.

name: Dr. Anam Kashif
review: Consulted Dr. Anam on video from another city. She guided me honestly on whether I even needed braces — no pushing, just genuine advice.
